messages:
maria: FYI — pushed a tiny tokenizer fix to main that prevents rare split-join corruption on long prompts. Needs hotfix rollout to eu-west1 during the 22:00-23:00 change window. low-risk but high-repro priority from cs.

deploy-bot: @maria detected a new tag 'hotfix/tokenizer-2026-03-21' on service-inference. Ready to start staged rollout when you confirm. Command: `rbctl rollout start --service tokenizer --tag hotfix/tokenizer-2026-03-21 --policy staged --canary 5%`.

jonathan: I can be on standby for the window. Can we do a short canary (5%) then 30m observe? If telemetry looks clean, proceed. :thumbsup:

maria: yes please. target: 5% -> 25% after 10m -> 100% after 30m if no regressions. rollback on any tokenization mismatch rate >0.02% or latency P99 increase >50ms.

samir: tagging @release-manager for expedited approvals (we need 2 approvers to bypass normal 48h wait). This is customer-impacting if left unfixed.

release-manager: I see the change. Quick checklist: release notes summary, smoke test commands, and rollback playbook. post the small release note and the smoke test curl.

maria: Release notes: "Tokenizer: fix for rare join-split corruption in long prompts (hotfix). No model changes."
Smoke test:
```
curl -s -X POST https://eu1.api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input": "<long prompt repeat 1000>"}' | jq .tokens | grep -q 'INVALID_JOIN' && echo FAIL || echo OK
```
Rollback command: `rbctl rollout rollback --service tokenizer --tag hotfix/tokenizer-2026-03-21 --to previous`

deploy-bot: Approval gate: requires 2 approvers from [release-manager, ops-oncall, senior-eng]. Current approvals: 0. To approve, react with :white_check_mark: or reply `approve`.

jonathan: approve — I'm happy to sign off for eng. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: approve — will monitor logs and perf for the 30m window. I'll have dashboard alerts up. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: jonathan, ops-oncall. Proceeding to schedule rollout within change window at 22:05 UTC. Staged plan: 5% -> wait 10m -> 25% -> wait 20m -> 100%.

maria: Starting rollout now (22:05). Posting progress updates.

deploy-bot: Rollout event: stage=canary, percent=5, started_by=maria, ts=5623456795

maria: canary logs look clean so far. no INVALID_JOIN events in sampling. latency P50/P99 unchanged.

deploy-bot: Rollout event: stage=progress, percent=25, ts=5623456805

ops-oncall: Observability: no error spikes; tokenization mismatch still 0.0%. Continuing.

maria: moving to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout event: stage=complete, percent=100, ts=5623456815 — Completed successfully.

samir: Nice. I'll draft the short release note for customer comms and mark the incident as resolved.

release-manager: Thanks all. Tagging this as "hotfix-resolved" in the release tracker and attaching the smoke test results. Please file a post-deploy note in the change log with the observability snapshot.

maria: Added post-deploy: observability snapshot + few example traces. Closing the thread. :shipit:
